text: All events being equally real. <break time="0.8s" /> Does not mean. <break time="0.8s" /> That all events deserve the same cognitive or emotional response. <break time="0.8s" /> At every moment we think about them. <break time="0.8s" /> The adaptive advantages of this manner of representing the world. <break time="0.8s" /> Help explain. <break time="0.8s" /> Why it is a feature of our species cognitive and affective systems. <break time="0.8s" /> Thinking of the world. <break time="0.8s" /> As divided into past, present, and future. <break time="0.8s" /> Can be useful. <break time="0.8s" /> Even if the world neither is dynamic. <break time="0.8s" /> Nor even appears dynamic. <break time="0.8s" /> It is essential to our prospects of survival. <break time="0.8s" /> That we respond differentially to events. <break time="0.8s" /> According to their causal relation to us. <break time="0.8s" /> At any given time. <break time="0.8s" /> For any sort of being. <break time="0.8s" /> Who acts on the basis of beliefs rather than exclusively on instinct. <break time="0.8s" /> Taking the right actions at the right times. <break time="0.8s" /> Is often dependent on having beliefs. <break time="0.8s" /> Like Now is the time to eat, sleep, resist, run away. <break time="0.8s" /> Our ancestors derived tremendous advantage. <break time="0.8s" /> From their capacity to plan ahead. <break time="0.8s" /> And to engage in collaborative activities. <break time="0.8s" /> Over periods of time. <break time="0.8s" /> Other species do a lot of things really well. <break time="0.8s" /> But the complex collaborative activities that demand explicit time consciousness. <break time="0.8s" /> Also define the evolutionary niche humans have enjoyed.
